crossRefs.note: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you, and hear your wisdom.
Blessed be Yahweh your God, who delighted in you, to set you on his throne, to be king for Yahweh your God; because…
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them: for she…

translations.bsb: How blessed are your men! How blessed are these servants of yours who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
translations.kjv: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.
